# churchnearyou

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

Scrape tidy data from the Church of England's [A Church Near You](https://www.achurchnearyou.com/) service. A work in progress. Currently you can use `cny_churches()` to get parish codes and Church Near You urls for every church in the Church of England, and you can pass the urls to `cny_scrape()` to get tidy data on the events listed for each church.

## Installation

You can install the development version of churchnearyou from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("Church-Army/churchnearyou")
```
